verdict.rationale: SumUp does not document a native, user-configurable automation or scheduling engine. Background automations have to be built outside SumUp, using the Agent Toolkit with LangChain, AI SDK or OpenAI Agents SDK, the managed MCP server, or the JS SDK running on platforms like Cloudflare Workers or Vercel. Event triggers are limited: webhooks only notify on checkout status changes, and the only built-in automation mentioned is 'automated marketing' in a POS plan tier. Missing for 10: native automation/workflow builder, scheduled or recurring background jobs, broader event triggers beyond checkout status, documentation of autonomous agent execution hosted by SumUp, independent corroboration.
